## Summary

F0011 feature run `2026-11-22-885e8734`, closed through G0–G8.

One authored JSON Schema 2020-12 source now ships as an **offline, hash-admitted 21-resource bundle**. Source-gated generated Pydantic models, a headless AJV consumer and a shared OpenAPI snapshot all read it.

- **brain-contracts:** a closed local registry with no network retrieval. Native-compat and portable profiles are selected before input, and there is no fallback.
- **API:** response guards on FactSlot read (after authorization and read audit) and commit (inside the mutation, so failures roll back). Both 500 handlers now log a correlatable `traceId` without instance data or exception text.
- **Consumers:** content, assertion, FactSlot and temporal commit delegate to the shared bundle, keeping their existing reasons and READ order.
- **Tooling and CI:** generator, a 443-case cross-language checker, installed wheel/sdist smoke tests, `docker/contracts` validation targets and a new `contracts` CI job.
- **Neuron:** SoupSieve 2.9.2 → 4.1.3, lock-only. This clears four pre-existing advisories.

## Evidence (run folder `planning-mds/operations/evidence/runs/2026-11-22-885e8734/`)

| Check | Result |
|---|---|
| Unit / PostgreSQL / full Neuron | 1239 / 83 / 265 passed (0 failed; 48 environment opt-in skips) |
| Cross-language conformance | 443 cases, 1329 results, 0 mismatches (jsonschema, Pydantic, AJV) |
| Changed-line coverage | Python 86.4%, JS 98.5%; per-package no-DB CI gates pass (brain_api 82.9%) |
| Canonical images | engine / node / neuron build and pass offline; clean context matches source |
| Scans | dependency 0 advisories; secrets 0; SAST 1 informational; DAST 119 pass |
| Reviews | Code APPROVED; Security PASS (PR-L3 read-audit disposition accepted) |
| G4 | Operator approved after the three G3 Lows were fixed |

## Notes for reviewers

- **ADR-0079:** all five acceptance proofs are met (`architect-implementation-review.md`), but the ADR stays **Proposed**. Acceptance is a separate operator decision.
- **Archived:** the feature folder moved to `features/archive/`, with links repaired. KG bindings cover all 114 new source files by literal path, because they were untracked at G7. They can be collapsed to globs later.
- **Evidence not committed:** third-party wheels/sdists, binary `.coverage` databases, SAST source snapshots and superseded raw V8 captures are excluded by a run-local `.gitignore`. Their hashes are kept in the receipts. Registry-wide evidence and tracker validation pass with those files absent.
- **Coverage layer:** `coverage-report.yaml` was regenerated at commit time, because staging the new files changed which files git tracks. KG drift and validation are green.
- **First CI run:** this PR is the first GitHub Actions run of the new `contracts` job. It was reproduced locally with the identical image targets.
